description.text: Schedule of Summer Short-term Program 2013 Application Deadline June 30 Registration Time Jul 10-11 Test Time Jul 13 Lecture Duration Jul 16-Aug 10 2013 Summer ShortShort-term Program (4 weeks) Date Teaching and Activities Date Teaching and Activities Morning Afternoon Morning Afternoon Wed Regstration and Orientation Sat Self-Support Travell Thu Sun Fri 9:00 am Placement Test Mon Lecture Topic Lecture Sat Free Arrangement Tue Lecture Sun Wed Lecture Visiting Mon Lecture Topic Lecture Thu Lecture Tue Lecture Fri Lecture Topic Lecture Wed Lecture Visiting Sat Free Arrangement Thu Lecture Sun Fri Lecture Topic Lecture Mon Lecture Topic Lecture Sat Free Arrangement Tue Lecture Sun Wed Lecture Visiting Mon Lecture Topic Lecture Thu Lecture Tue Lecture Fri Lecture Graduation Ceremony Wed Lecture Visiting Sat Checking Out and Leaving Thu Lecture Sun Fri Lecture Topic Lecture Topic lectures shadow-boxing Chinese calligraphy Chinese folk music Paper-cutting Chinese Chinese songs Phonetic Chinese manner Chinese films Peking opera General introduction of China Chinese geography of travelling Visiting Central Avenue Sun Island Historical Museum Observation of Countryside Tigger Zoo Polarland Temple of Confucius Jile Buddhist Temple Self-supporting Travelling Wudalianchi Inner Mongalia Jingpo Lake Lake of Heaven on Changbai Mountain Fees 1. Tuition fee: The first week is RMB 1500, week two, three, four is RMB 400/week, and RMB 2700 in total for four weeks. One to one lecture is RMB 120 per lecture. 2. Registration Fee: RMB 260 3. Dormitory: RMB 41/person/day (District A), RMB 60/person/day (District C), all of the above prices are for double rooms, single room should be pay for double price. 4. Charges of the self-support travel depends on the travel agency, and it normally will be around RMB 1000. Characteristics 1 .Study Helpers; 2 .Lecturers conduct with students; 3 .Topic lectures of chinese culture; 4 .The teaching content will focus on the pronunciation. Remark a.We provide free picking up services, students should inform us the flight details 3 days before you arrival. b.All of the activities convene in the lobby of No. 3 building, distict A. c.Short-term programm students should checkout rooms on time.

duration.text: The Short-term Program in Summer Holiday at Heilongjiang University is a 4 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 375 USD/In total ￥ 2700 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 4.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant

requirements.text: Applicants should have self-care ability with good health.
